title: A court order for not filing Form D bars Rules 504 and 506
rule: No Rule 504 or Rule 506 exemption is available to an issuer if it, a predecessor or an affiliate has been enjoined by a court for failing to comply with Rule 503, the Form D filing rule. The SEC may lift the bar on a showing of good cause.

sources.title: 17 CFR 230.507, Disqualifying provision relating to exemptions under Rules 504 and 506
